semantics: Optional minCalibrationRows, min_calibration_rows or min-calibration-rows must be a positive safe integer in a blocking manifest.
Count paired boolean verdicts only, including false/false. One-sided, unlabelled and axis-only rows do not count.
Shared calibration preflight recomputes a declared floor for the relevant judge; another judge cannot inflate it.
Omitted floors add no new count requirement. Report-only manifest bars remain unenforced as normal blocking gates; evidence qualification still checks declared bars.
Duplicate row identities remain rejected by existing gate checks. A count alone proves neither statistical independence nor representative class coverage.
